svg.title: Project 1 Workflow: From Raw Data to Model Comparison
svg.desc: A four-stage workflow showing data cleaning, feature engineering, unsupervised exploration via PCA and k-means, and supervised modeling with five algorithms culminating in test set comparison.
svg.text: Project 1 Pipeline: Raw CMS Data → Model Comparison
